selection: One candidate per canonical model; among otherwise eligible time-ended attempts with a last key in the final two minutes, choose the closest last key to the deadline, then the latest start, then the session ID. Milestone scores are not used.
interpretation: Retrospective, selected submission examples, not all-attempt success rates, IID replicates or a controlled estimate of the effect of a longer budget. The screen and model mappings require author confirmation before final submission.
provenance: The contributor clarified that the archive mixes retries, interrupted attempts and intended submissions. Exact per-attempt stop causes have not all been verified. The final-two-minute screen is a conservative proposal for review, not an original preregistered protocol.
